description: Moments of a video post: its direct replies that carry a 'network.eurosky.mediaTime' field (the second of the video a reply is about), grouped by that second. Every reply adds a bump about 10 seconds wide to a curve along the video, and the moments are the hills of that curve: two neighbouring hills are two moments where the curve between them dips at least 30% below the lower top. Replies that are taken down, by taken-down accounts or against the thread's reply rules are left out.

replyCount.description: Linked replies counted across all moments.

truncated.description: True when the post has more linked replies than the AppView reads in one request (10,000); the moments then cover only part of them.

startSeconds.description: Where to start playing: where the moment's hill rises above half its height, at most 5 seconds before its first reply. Can be after a stray first reply.

endSeconds.description: The second of the moment's latest reply.

unansweredCount.description: How many of the moment's replies by other accounts the video post's author has not replied to directly. Counts all of the moment's replies, not only the listed ones.

replies.description: Up to 100 of the moment's replies, by second.

authorReplied.description: True when the video post's author replied directly to this reply.
